lessons.title: Cellular Architecture: Neurons & The Glial Support Matrix
lessons.description: Understand the morphology of neurons, dendritic spines, axonal transport, and the vital functions of astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, and microglia.

lessons.title: The Electrochemical Spark: Resting Potential & The Action Potential
lessons.description: Master membrane biophysics: ion distributions, the sodium-potassium pump, voltage-gated ion channels, refractory periods, and saltatory conduction.

lessons.title: Synaptic Transmission: Chemical Messengers & Receptor Mechanisms
lessons.description: Explore calcium influx, vesicular exocytosis, ligand-gated ionotropic vs. metabotropic receptors, EPSPs, IPSPs, and spatial/temporal summation.

lessons.title: Neurotransmitters & Neuromodulators: The Chemical Palette
lessons.description: Examine the major neurotransmitter systems: Glutamate, GABA, Acetylcholine, Dopamine, Serotonin, and Norepinephrine, along with receptor kinetics.
